2: Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects the validity of the herein referenced ordinances or any ordinance amendatory or supplemental thereto. Such ordinances continue in full force and effect as if set out at length in this chapter Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this code affects the validity of the ordinance creating powers, laws, regulation’s created or enacted or creating the City of Summerville Development Authority and any other authority created by prior act of the City. The City of Summerville Retirement Plan as it exists at the time of adoption of this ordinance and its applications to those positions that continue to exist under this Charter and Code of Ordinances. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects the City of Summerville Zoning Ordinance. Unless otherwise and expressly amended therein the City of Summerville Zoning Ordinance shall remain in full force and effect. The City of Summerville Personnel Policy as marked, see Appendix _____, specifically, Chapter 22, Article I, Federal Old Age and Survivors Insurance, and Chapter 22, Article II, State Employees’ Retirement System, as it exists at the time of adoption of this ordinance and its applications to those positions that continue to exist under this Charter and Code of Ordinances. The City of Summerville Utilities Code, Chapter 32, as it exists at the time of adoption of this ordinance and its applications to those positions that continue to exist under this Charter and Code of Ordinances. The City of Summerville Vehicles for Hire Ordinances, Chapter 34, as it exists at the time of adoption of this ordinance and its applications to those positions that continue to exist under this Charter and Code of Ordinances. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects all ordinances regulating and controlling industrial use of the waste water and waste water facilities. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects ordinances adopting the protection of watersheds and recharge areas for protection of watersheds. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects ordinances regulating signs and creating historical districts. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects legislative acts, contracts and franchises that constitute legal obligations of the City or obligations of others to the City. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects the Alcoholic Beverages ordinance as revised by this ordinance or the preceding ordinance, except where conflicting, is saved from repeal. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects the City of Summerville Retirement Plan as superseded by Adoptive Agreement and General Addendum effective February 14, 2011. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects the legislative acts, ordinances and contracts regulating or pertaining to the operation of the City of Summerville natural gas systems, water systems and sewer system as amended by these ordinances. The existing ordinances are saved from repeal. The following Boards and their current members shall remain as composed and as constituted upon adoption of this Code and the ordinance adopting this code.
